newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 28.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - South Africa to cut diplomatic ties with Taiwan at end of 1997.
Before his decision to switch ties to China, South African President Mandela twice met Taiwan ambassador in South Africa.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - South African President Mandela says willing to meet Taiwan President Lee Teng-hui, will maintain constructive relations with Taiwan.
Taxes collected on labour pension funds to be returned in full to workers.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Bidding documents for telecommunications projects suspected of being changed by officials; communications ministry denies allegations.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Under new guideliness, private Taiwan wine makers must have minimum paid-in capital of T$200 million (US$7.3 million).
